name: Tenda Peppers Chilli Variety Reference Data
description: Public reference data for Chinese chilli varieties supplied or described by Tenda Peppers. Heat values are representative ranges and should be confirmed for a target quotation.

mainEntity.name: Jinta Chilli
mainEntity.description: Medium-heat chilli from Gansu and Xinjiang at 10,000–20,000 SHU. Long 11–14 cm pods with thick, glossy, deep jujube-red skin; used for visible chilli flakes, colour, seasoning and chilli paste.

additionalProperty.name: Fruit Type
additionalProperty.value: Long pod (11–14 cm), thick glossy skin

mainEntity.name: Lantern Pepper (Denglongjiao)
mainEntity.description: Medium-heat whole chilli at 10,000–20,000 SHU from Shandong and Hebei, with balanced colour, aroma and flavour. Lantern-shaped pods are used for dry-pot, hot-pot and food service where the chilli stays visible.

mainEntity.name: Zidantou (Bullet) Chilli
mainEntity.description: Conical bullet-shaped high-heat chilli at 20,000–50,000 SHU from Shandong and Anhui. Used as a dependable base for hot sauce, industrial food and chilli powder.

mainEntity.name: Jixin (Chicken-Heart) Chilli
mainEntity.description: Small heart-shaped extra-hot pod at 50,000–70,000 SHU from Guizhou and Hunan. Standard for extreme-heat products, chilli oil and Sichuan-style dishes.

additionalProperty.name: Best For
additionalProperty.value: Extreme heat, chilli oil, Sichuan dishes

mainEntity.name: Xiaomi Chilli
mainEntity.description: Small slender extra-hot chilli at 50,000–70,000 SHU from Yunnan and Guizhou. Its compact pod concentrates heat, making it suitable for high-heat whole chillies, segments and chilli oil.
